name: vibeschool-evidence-certification
description: Define evidence grades and completion semantics for VibeSchool verification and certification.
---
# Evidence and Certification
IMPLEMENTED means code exists. VERIFIED means relevant behavior has current direct evidence. CERTIFIED means all required governed/independent gates pass for the exact candidate. MERGED means GitHub confirms the exact intended head landed. PRODUCTION_VERIFIED requires current deployed/runtime evidence. Record evidence source, SHA/version, environment, scope, freshness and contradictions. Certification cannot be inherited across changed heads.
